record.measurement_method: fine-tuned CHGNet MD simulations with Arrhenius extrapolation to room temperature
record.evidence_quote: the ionic conductivity at room temperature, extrapolated from the Arrhenius curve, increased to 4.53 mS/cm
record.notes: Value is extrapolated to room temperature from MD-derived Li MSD (fine-tuned CHGNet, 1000 K Arrhenius fit), not experimentally measured. The same value appears in the abstract as 'a high ionic conductivity of 4.53 mS/cm'. The migration barrier of 0.24 eV is a migration energy barrier, not reported as the conductivity activation energy, so activation_energy_eV is left null. No numeric conductivity is given for pristine LZSP in the text, so no record was made for it.
